source: NASA FIRMS VIIRS 375 m active fire detections, binned to the whole-park grid
note: Each entry is a satellite detection of a hot spot, located to about 375 m. Not a fire perimeter. Grid: the whole of Khao Yai National Park as 131 x 187 cells of 500 m, the park plus a 5 km margin on every side. inside is 1 when more than half of the cell's sample points lie inside the park polygon, else 0.
